notes.title: Changelog 6/24
notes.notes:
Simple and normal difficulty changed to resurrection unlimited times

 Reduce difficulty
  - Normal difficulty, all enemies applying debuff fire are changed to level 1 fire (2%->1% deduction)
  - Normal difficulty, volcano world, reduce the number of enemies in the level configuration of the enemy
  - All difficulty, the enemy's crit rate is reduced (150%/200%/250%->130%/150%/200%)

Bug fix
  - Fixed the bug that the position of the affix is incorrect in the strange resolution
  - Fixed the bug that the hovering box of the defeated interface skill will flash
  - Fixed the bug that the hover box is not visible in the career interface

Others
- Increased probability of treasure Goblin (15%/20%/25%->15%/25%/35%)

notes.title: 《Million Dungeon》Changelog 05/14
notes.notes:
- New hero: Ice Crystal Skeleton

- Numerical adjustment
  - All mechanical units gain magic immunity
  - So it takes 2 clicks to release the units to get magic immunity (Big Fire Dragon, Car Rush)
  - There are more monsters on ice fields and volcanoes, which can now make multiple units into an abnormal state

- Optimization
  - The number of remaining rounds will be displayed when the enemy is frozen

- New achievements
  - 6 foods in one battle still dies
  - Number of combos reaches 666
  - Gold coins reached 80,000 upon death
  - Players did not hit any target after eliminating non-medical units for 5 consecutive rounds.

- New recruits
  - Time and Space Apprentice: Reduces the skill CD when eliminating, and increases the skill level when equipped.
  - Ice Frog: Random long-range attack, which can freeze enemies during the five eliminations. (Similar to dizziness, but the injury is halved)
  - Ice Dragon: Random long-range attack, which can freeze enemies during the five eliminations. (Similar to dizziness, but the injury is halved)
  - Demon Flower: Melee attack, which increases the number of abnormal rounds on the enemy when hit.

notes.title: 《Million Dungeon》Changelog 04/23
notes.notes:
New events
  - 3 worlds:
    - Nightmare strikes (Unlock the slave route reached in 2 worlds)
  - 4 worlds:
    - Entangling nightmare (2 worlds reached the slave route to unlock)
  - 5 worlds:
    - Goblin Evening News 2 (Unlock after completing the [Goblin Evening News], [4 World GE], the corresponding option to unlock needs to complete the event: [Brother ’s Choice], [Next Generation Argument], [Secure Place]]
    - Addict 3 ([Magic Addict 2] allows him to consume the magic power and complete the [Mage ’s Mission] to unlock it, and the [Elves ’Old Country] will disappear)
    - Hometown of Fairies (choose to agree in [Outlier Fairy])
    - Abandoned alchemy (Unlock after completing [Mage's Mission], and disappear after completing [Elves' Old Country])
    - Abandoned Alchemy 2 (Unlock after completing [Mage's Mission], [Abandoned Alchemy], and disappear after completing [Elves' Old Country])
    - Endless nightmares (Unlock slave routes reached in 2 worlds)
  - 6 worlds:
    - Corruption
    - Corruption 2 (Complete [Corruption] Unlock)
    - Corruption 3 (Complete [Corruption 2] Unlock)
    - Car accident

Optimization
  - Some skills and props will enjoy the iron backpack bonus
  - Bomb CD will be affected by doping
  - Some UI adjustments
  - Dot damage received by heroes is now rounded down
  - Players now have no option to refuse when they receive a cursed relic
  - The reward and punishment for the maximum HP | MP | SP in the plot are based on the final value of 
    the equipment bonus as the reference value
  - The order of enemy actions is from bottom to top and from left to right

Bug fix
  - Fixed text error in some battle logs
  - Fixed the bug that when the relic is full, the error message will be displayed in the hover box of the 
    interface for getting the details of the relic
  - Fixed the bug that the owl will be killed by anti-injury
  - Fixed the issue that the curse--small package caused the backpack to display incorrectly
  - Fixed the issue where the blood pendant could not trigger the passive bonus of the fallen priest
  - Fixed an issue where the pre-emptive action of the volcano boss caused the game to freeze
  - Fixed the display problem of some of our buff / debuff icons
  - Fixed the problem that the tombstone is killed by lightning and it will cause the game to freeze
  - Fixed an issue where the Thunderbolt Totem would freeze after killing the Skeletal Mage

notes.title: MillionDungeon Changelog 2020/04/10
notes.notes:
New hero-Thunder Shaman
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021705/b6dc26173cc0b78b4632e29f23e9a87e1a55670c.png
  - Initial values: SP600, HP600, MP600
  - Initial arms: swordsman, electrode tower, self-propelled crossbow, angel
  - New soldiers-electrode tower [shield]:
  - At the end of each round, absorb the debuff of the nine-squared grid into hero SP
  - When eliminated, it causes long-range damage to the enemy with paralysis effect
  - Passive skills: Killing enemies in paralyzed state can return 4%, and it is immune to paralysis
  - Active skill one: "Thunderbolt Totem" is dropped in the enemy camp. The totem damages and numbs the enemies around the eighth house every round for 3 rounds.
  - Active Technique 2: Thunder falls randomly throughout the game, causing damage and paralysis. If it hits the Thunder Totem, it will trigger an attack effect.

New function-affix system
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021705/68082dab75091f72a304785cad6886a9bdbd5553.png
  - In most descriptions, the game-specific nouns involved appear in the form of affixes.
  - The affix will pop up on the edge of the window.

 New function-battle log
it will display the calculation information of hero status changes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021705/82c9c84a1c635264f6c6abbfb8cf26eb79f0ac33.png

Bug
  - Fixed the bug that boss-volcano summoner cannot summon bombs normally
  - Fixed the bug that the enemy debuff status is invalid
  - Fixed the bug that the red car can not be synthesized into a big car

Optimization
  - Show unlock conditions of Mighty Warlock
  - The combat log can be set to switch, will be affected by the mind
  - UI changes on enemy details page
  - All long-press operations in the PC version have been changed to right-click operations
  - Optimization of some special effects and bullets
  - Modified the skill icon of the fallen priest
  - Enemies in a paralyzed state will not be able to critically strike (no effect on their pieces)

Numerical adjustment
  - Arms-Unicorns: Attack power is slightly lowered, hit count doubled
  - Hotel-HP cultivation maximum reduction: 450-> 350
  - Hotel-SP practice maximum reduction: 600-> 450
  - Hero-Fallen Priest: Increases the HP consumption of 2 skills by a constant 55%. The maximum value of the magnification is unchanged, and the rise of the magnification is smoother.
  - Hero-skeleton general: Increases the number of consecutive rounds of skill defense defense. (2-> 3)
  - Hero-Captain Phalanx: Increases the skill by 1 to increase the number of continuous shield gain rounds. (1-2)
  - Hero-Void Elf: greatly increase the damage multiplier of 2 skills. (2 times full level-> 15 times full level)
  - Hero-Void Elf: Reduces the cooldown of skill by 1. (5-> 4)
  - Enemy-Tar Slime: Attack frequency reduced (1 round-> 2 rounds)
  - Arms-Increase the basic critical strike chance of Splash Arms, Great Axe Fighter, Abomination, Mantis (3 Matches 5%, 5 Matches 10%-> 3 Matches 8%, Five Matches 30%)
  - Improve the crit rate of boss difficulty: 15% -20%
  - Arms-Phalanx: After joining the battle, provide the hero with an additional 400 | 800 | 1400 | 2000 Sp
  - Arms-Elves: After joining the battle, provide an additional 400 | 800 | 1400 | 2000 Mp for the hero
  - Relics-Sirens: 90%-> 80% damage reduction adjustment

BUG

     appear in the store

Balance adjustment

  -RelicsDamaged Pocketwatch: Maximum number of days increased (5-> 6)
